card.line: Arad was a Canaanite city in the Negev, south of Hebron, whose king attacked Israel in the wilderness and is later listed among the kings of the land.

moments.title: Arad's king attacks Israel
moments.text: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming along the road to Atharim. He attacked Israel and captured some prisoners.

moments.title: The Kenites live near Arad
moments.text: The descendants of Moses' father-in-law, the Kenite, went up with the men of Judah to the Wilderness of Judah in the Negev. They settled near Arad and lived among the people.
